description: KP Green Engineering Ltd commissioned a new steel fabrication and hot-dip galvanizing facility at Matar village, Bharuch district, Gujarat, adding 2.94 lakh MT per annum of capacity and featuring what the company describes as Asia's largest galvanizing kettle (56 cubic metres, 1,100-tonne zinc capacity). Facility was inaugurated by Gujarat Deputy CM Harsh Sanghavi on 24 Dec 2025; company states total operational capacity (4,00,500 TPA) will be reached only once the plant is fully operational in 2026, hence classified as Nearing Completion rather than fully Completed. Self-executed; no separate civil contractor disclosed.

name: Patil Group Chandrapur Spring Steel Wire Plant
description: Patil Group is setting up a greenfield spring steel wire production plant with 50,000 MTPA capacity in Chandrapur, Maharashtra, covering wire diameters of 0.2mm to 8.0mm for automotive, power, construction and engineering applications, including a fully automated tunnel pickling line. Exact operating subsidiary within the Patil Group not specified in source; investment value and precise timeline not disclosed. Self-executed; no separate civil contractor disclosed.

name: Bansal Wire Industries Sanand Greenfield Wire and Steel Plant
description: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd is setting up a Rs 600 crore greenfield project on a 42-acre site in Sanand, Gujarat, comprising a 1.8 lakh-tonne induction-based steel unit and a 60,000-tonne low-carbon and stainless steel wire manufacturing unit, including tyre bead wire, targeted for completion by September 2027. Project includes a 1.8 lakh TPA induction-furnace steelmaking unit (backward integration) alongside the 60,000 TPA wire-processing unit; included here on the basis of its wire-manufacturing component, which is the company's core downstream processing business. Land (42 acres) acquired for approx Rs 80-90 crore. Self-executed; no separate civil contractor disclosed.

name: Bansal Wire Dadri Steel Cord Manufacturing Plant
description: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd is building India's first indigenous steel cord manufacturing facility at its Dadri (Greater Noida) plant in Uttar Pradesh, starting with a 20,000-tonne pilot unit costing Rs 150 crore, as part of a planned Rs 2,500 crore steel cord investment to reduce import dependence for tyre reinforcement material. Rs 150 crore figure is for the initial 20,000-tonne pilot facility, scheduled for commissioning by end of 2026; full steel cord vertical envisages up to Rs 2,500 crore of the company's Rs 3,500 crore five-year capex plan, phased over the next three years. Self-executed; no separate civil contractor disclosed.

name: Daikin India Third Manufacturing Facility, Sri City
description: Daikin Airconditioning India set up its third integrated manufacturing facility at Sri City, Andhra Pradesh, with an investment of Rs 1,000 crore, making it one of the company's largest air-conditioner production bases in India; commercial production was announced in November 2023. Foundation stone laid around April 2022; commercial production announced November 2023. Exact day-level dates not disclosed in sources, so left null rather than guessed.

name: Climaveneta HVAC Manufacturing Plant, Narsapura
description: Mitsubishi Electric Group company Climaveneta Climate Technologies invested Rs 400 crore in a manufacturing facility at Narsapura (Kolar district), Karnataka, to produce central air-conditioning equipment such as screw chillers, magnetic levitation chillers, and heat pumps; the plant was inaugurated on November 8, 2024.

name: Voltas Room AC Manufacturing Plant, Madharapakkam
description: Voltas built a new Room Air Conditioner manufacturing facility spread over 150 acres at Madharapakkam in Thiruvallur district, Tamil Nadu, with a planned investment of over Rs 500 crore; the Bhoomi Pujan was held on May 24, 2023 and commercial operations began during FY2024-25. Commercial production commenced during FY2024-25 (April 2024-March 2025); exact commissioning date not disclosed in sources.

name: Amber Enterprises Ultra Mega AC Manufacturing Facility, YEIDA
description: Amber Enterprises broke ground on a 100-acre 'Ultra Mega' air-conditioner and electronics-component manufacturing facility in Sector 8, YEIDA (near Jewar Airport), Uttar Pradesh, with a disclosed investment of Rs 3,532 crore, on June 27, 2026. This is one of two facilities in a combined Rs 6,785 crore Amber Group YEIDA announcement; Rs 3,532 crore is specifically the Sector 8 AC/electronics-component plant figure. The other component, a Rs 3,250 crore PCB/semiconductor-substrate plant in Sector 10 by group JV Ascent-K Circuit, is not HVAC-related and is excluded here.

name: Intellion Park District Cooling System, Chennai
description: Tata Power, in a consortium with Keppel's infrastructure arm, will deploy a 12,100 TR AI-driven Cooling-as-a-Service district cooling system for Tata Realty's Intellion Park IT campus (25.27 acres) in Chennai's Taramani corridor, under a 15-year agreement targeted to go live in October 2026. Contract value not publicly disclosed. Structured as a 15-year Cooling-as-a-Service agreement (12,100 TR capacity) rather than a fixed-price construction contract; go-live targeted for October 2026.
contractor: Tata Power Trading Company Limited / Keppel Infrastructure (consortium)
client: Infopark Properties Limited (Tata Realty & Infrastructure Ltd)

name: Blue Star Sri City RAC Plant Phase 3 Expansion
description: Blue Star is investing Rs 200 crore in a third-phase capacity expansion of its Sri City, Andhra Pradesh plant, adding 12 lakh units of room air-conditioner production capacity (from 8.5 lakh units), part of a broader Rs 400 crore FY26 capex plan announced in March 2025. Part of Blue Star's Rs 400 crore FY26 capacity expansion plan announced March 2025; specific commissioning date not disclosed.

name: Blue Star Himachal Pradesh Commercial AC Facility Expansion
description: Blue Star is investing Rs 150 crore to expand its commercial air-conditioning manufacturing facility in Himachal Pradesh, as part of its Rs 400 crore FY26 capacity expansion plan announced in March 2025. Part of Blue Star's Rs 400 crore FY26 capacity expansion plan; the specific town/city within Himachal Pradesh and commissioning date are not disclosed in the source, so city is left null rather than guessed.

name: EPACK Durable Andhra Pradesh Manufacturing Expansion
description: EPACK Durable and its subsidiary EPACK Manufacturing Technologies received Andhra Pradesh government approval for a combined Rs 1,084.31 crore investment to expand room air-conditioner, key-component, and other consumer-durables manufacturing capacity, with 36.41 acres of land allotted at Rs 60 lakh/acre under the state's Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0. Andhra Pradesh government approval reported around July 2026 under Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0. Combined figure includes Rs 314.31 crore from EPACK Durable and Rs 770 crore from subsidiary EPACK Manufacturing Technologies (EMTPL); exact plant location/city not specified in source, so left null.
client: EPACK Durable Limited / EPACK Manufacturing Technologies Pvt Ltd

name: Havells Lloyd AC Capacity Expansion, Ghiloth and Sri City
description: Havells India's Lloyd brand invested Rs 50-60 crore to expand air-conditioner manufacturing capacity at its Ghiloth (Rajasthan) and Sri City (Andhra Pradesh) plants, raising combined annual capacity toward about 3 million units, targeted for completion by Q4 FY25 (by March 2025). Investment reported across sources as a Rs 50-60 crore range (funded via internal accruals); expansion spans two plants, Ghiloth in Rajasthan and Sri City in Andhra Pradesh (some secondary sources mislabel Sri City as being in Tamil Nadu); state/city fields here reflect the Ghiloth site only.

name: Airedale by Modine Data Center Cooling Facility, Chennai
description: Modine officially opened a new 100,000 sq ft manufacturing facility in Chennai, Tamil Nadu on August 21, 2025 to produce Airedale by Modine data-center cooling equipment (starting with the AireWall ONE fan wall) for the Asia-Pacific region. Investment value not disclosed in company announcement.
